docs.description: Numeric input with stepper controls. 20 variants: size (sm, md) × state (default, hover, focus, disabled, error) × stepper (inline, side). inline places steppers inside the field trailing; side places them outside (larger hit area, preferred for touch). inputmode="numeric" for mobile keyboards. Validate on blur. Constrain via min / max / step; do not accept characters the field does not allow.

rules.reason: As Text Input: MUI's InputBase on the web, as the field, for its native number input (a spinbutton, with min, max and step, and the arrow keys stepping); Flutter's TextField, undecorated, as its number, stepped by the arrow keys too. The steppers are buttons drawn from Figma's layers with the shared layer helpers, the label and helper as Text Input's.
Each stepper lays the field out its own way: inline, the minus and plus sit inset.sm from the number (inset.xs at sm); beside it, the stepper column meets the number with no gap.
As the gap: the number sits inset.md in from the field's edge beside a side stepper, which meets the field's right edge (no right padding), and inset.sm either side inline.
As the left padding, the side stepper's column flush with the field's right edge.
Inline, the field hugs its number and its buttons; beside a side stepper, it is Figma's fixed 88 (md) and 68 (sm), the number filling what the column leaves.
As the minus's, a step smaller.
The stepper's divider is a hairline, 1px, border.default's width, as Divider's rule is: the same value.
Same values, governed tokens, a step of the icon ladder per size; the icon's height is already bound to them.
As Text Area's: Figma rings the whole component, label and helper with it, as well as the field, when it is focused. The focus ring is the field's, and one ring is drawn.
As inline's, one ring, the field's.
As Text Input's field: SOLAR publishes no control height token (owner decision 2026-09-23, raised as a governance gap). Drawn 40 (md) and 32 (sm).
Beside a side stepper, the field is 88 (md) and 68 (sm), bound to nothing: SOLAR has no control width token (the design review's question on control sizes).
The side stepper's column is 28 (md) and 24 (sm) wide, bound to nothing, as the field's width is.
Figma names the inline stepper's value by what it draws, a 0: the number in the field. A name made of a digit cannot become code; the side stepper's is already `Value`.
